windows-modern.description: Windows 10 build 17763 (1809) and newer (including Windows 11). Modern feature set: WGC capture, full UI Automation, mandatory integrity levels, UIPI, WIC image codecs, WIC-backed PNG/WebP/BMP. The default Windows family for new agent installs. Note: WGC was introduced in Win 10 1803 but stabilised in 1809; the modern floor is set at 1809 because earlier WGC behaviour was unreliable.
windows-modern.token_file_acl: Local Administrators (full control) + agent run-as account (read). Inherited permissions disabled. Token rotates on every agent start.

windows-legacy.description: Windows XP SP3 / Server 2003 SP2 / Vista / 7 / 8 / 8.1 / Server 2008 / 2008 R2 / 2012 / 2012 R2 / Win 10 builds before 1809. Built with the VS2017 v141_xp toolset on a modern dev workstation. UI Automation 3.0 (Vista+ via redist; in-box on 7+); GDI BitBlt capture; WIC encoders for PNG/WebP/BMP. No WGC (modern-floor API), no long-path support pre-Win-10-1607. Honours v2.2 MCP-stdio framing; rejects WS framing (RFC 6455 reserved for `windows-modern`). Wire-identity exists from Protocol v2.2 onward; pre-v2.2 the same agent code advertised itself as `windows-classic` on the wire.
windows-legacy.token_file_acl: Local Administrators (full control) + agent run-as account (read). Inherited permissions disabled. Token rotates on every agent start.

windows-classic.description: Windows NT 4.0 SP6a, Windows 95 OSR2 through ME, and Windows 2000. Built with the VS6 toolset on a Windows XP SP3 VM. No UI Automation, no WGC, no UIPI; GDI BitBlt capture only. PNG via GDI+ runtime if present (XP+ ships GDI+; NT 4 needs the redist). Multi-monitor on 2000 and later. Used for the earliest Windows agent build; Vista through Windows 8.1 / Win 10 pre-1809 are covered by the `windows-legacy` family, not classic.
windows-classic.token_file_acl: Local Administrators (full control) + agent run-as account (read), enforceable on NTFS only. On FAT32 the token file is plaintext-readable by every user on the machine; tier elevation degrades to a per-machine-trust model. Token rotates on every agent start.
